name: ollama-autocoder
description: A simple Ollama autocompletion engine for newer models: system-prompted completions with lookahead, streaming, and a git-diff proposal box

ollama-autocoder.endpoint.description: The Ollama REST endpoint. Defaults to the chat API (`/api/chat`). Point it at `/api/generate` only if your proxy exposes that instead.

ollama-autocoder.bearer token.markdownDescription: API Bearer token for reverse proxies that require authentication. Not usually needed. [Set token](command:ollama-autocoder.setBearerToken)

ollama-autocoder.model.description: The model to use for generating completions

ollama-autocoder.think.description: Whether to send 'think: true' to the model. Thinking/reasoning models emit their reply into a separate reasoning stream, leaving the completion (message.content) empty, so completions silently disappear. Leave this false unless you specifically want the model to reason. Only affects thinking-capable models.

ollama-autocoder.system prompt.default: You are an expert {LANG} code-completion engine for the project {PROJECT_NAME} (file {FILE_NAME}). Output only the code that belongs at the marker {REPLACEMENT_KEYWORD} and naturally continues toward the code that already follows. Match the surrounding indentation and style. All commentary MUST be a comment. Do not include any code fences. Your response is INSERTED DIRECTLY.
ollama-autocoder.system prompt.description: The system prompt sent to the model (replaces the old pseudo-system 'message header'). Placeholders {LANG}, {FILE_NAME}, {PROJECT_NAME}, and {REPLACEMENT_KEYWORD} are substituted. Keep the format the same if modified; leave blank for no system prompt.

ollama-autocoder.max tokens predicted.description: The maximum number of tokens generated by the model.

ollama-autocoder.prompt window size.description: The size of the prompt context window in characters (NOT tokens, so it can be set 1.3-4x the model's max tokens, varying significantly). If unsure, use a 1:1 token size.

ollama-autocoder.replacement keyword.description: The marker inserted at the cursor where the model begins its completion. It is sent to the model and used as a stop sequence so the model does not repeat it. A newline is added before it automatically. Choose something that does not appear in ordinary code.

ollama-autocoder.lookahead.description: Characters of code after the cursor to use as the completion's stop boundary for multi-line proposals. The model stops at the first non-empty line within this window so the proposal bridges into the code that already follows. Set to 0 to propose to the end of the document.

ollama-autocoder.completion keys.description: Characters that the autocompletion item provider appear on. '\n' is parsed as the newline character. REQUIRES RELOAD

ollama-autocoder.response preview.description: The inline completion label will be the first line of the response. If the first line is empty, the default label will be used. Not streamable; disable on slow devices.

ollama-autocoder.preview max tokens.description: The maximum number of tokens generated by the model for the response preview. Typically not reached as the preview stops on newline. Recommended to keep very low due to computational cost.

ollama-autocoder.preview delay.description: Time to wait in seconds before starting inline preview generation. Prevents the Ollama server from running briefly every time the completion key is pressed, which causes unnecessary compute usage. If you are not on a battery powered device, set this to 0 for a more responsive experience.

ollama-autocoder.temperature.description: Temperature of the model. It is recommended to set it lower than you would for dialogue.
